summary: Pins Ardent 3.2.0 and carries its runtime contracts through management (node agent studio level 4): execution recovery reads and the task-recovery action, execution lineage, artifact transfer v2 content relay with Range, renditions and peer imports, and execution context passthrough. Adds portable agent definitions (hive-agent-definition/1: export, preflight, install), pinned HiveSkills releases, and Ardent dependency discovery through the Hive Registry. No migrations. Release extension packages that pin an exact Ardent peer for 3.2.0 before upgrading managed agents.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_HIVE_REGISTRY_URL
newOptionalEnv.description: Hive Registry base URL used to discover Ardent dependencies (HiveMem, HiveSkills, Emberpath) when their explicit settings are unset. Unset turns discovery off.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_HIVE_REGISTRY_TOKEN_FILE
newOptionalEnv.description: File holding the Hive Registry read token for discovery. Sent only to MAGNUS_HIVE_REGISTRY_URL.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_HIVE_REGISTRY_ALLOW_HTTP
newOptionalEnv.description: Allow a plain-http Hive Registry on its private network. Default false.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_ARDENT_HIVESKILLS_TARGET
newOptionalEnv.description: HiveSkills target name Magnus uses to install pinned, non-promoted skill releases. Used only with MAGNUS_ARDENT_HIVESKILLS_URL.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_ARDENT_HIVESKILLS_TARGET_TOKEN_FILE
newOptionalEnv.description: File holding that HiveSkills target's enrollment token. Sent only to MAGNUS_ARDENT_HIVESKILLS_URL.
